clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, a prison riot has left Warden Thelwater besieged at the Stockade entrance. He calls for capable adventurers to stop the Defias prisoners before the uprising reaches the city above.

Beneath Stormwind's canals, the Stockade holds the kingdom's most dangerous miscreants, petty thieves, and political conspirators. Warden Thelwater was charged with keeping them locked away, but an organized revolt caught the guards off guard. The prisoners overwhelmed security and seized the cells, leaving Thelwater barricaded at the entrance as he struggles to contain an armed uprising beneath the capital's streets.
